propositions: closed bugs lacking close_class must be backfilled using structural signals only: reverts of STATUS/COMMITS events infer regression, plan-review BLOCKs infer plan_defect, gate_error_v1 records infer env_integration, otherwise undetermined

backfilled classifications are written to a separate git-tracked NDJSON file (.rebar/backfill-close-class.ndjson) with source=backfill_classified and confidence=classified to segregate from authoritative values
the backfill must be idempotent: bugs already processed or carrying authoritative close_class are skipped on re-run
reverts of COMMENT/LINK events do not constitute substantive reverts and must not infer regression

plan-review BLOCK signals are read via all_review_results; gate_error signals require raw event-file scanning of *-REVIEW_RESULT.json and *-COMPLETION_VERDICT.json files checking for schema==gate_error_v1
every backfilled record carries ticket_id, close_class, source, confidence, evidence, and ISO-8601 timestamp, and is_authoritative(record.source) must return False
